title: Trades frame
description: The `data` of a `trades` topic message on the panel socket: public trades for one venue and instrument, oldest first. The first frame after subscribing is the runtime's ring of recent trades (replay). Prices and sizes are decimal strings. Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (TradesFrame). See decision 0007 §2.14–2.15.

replay.description: True for the ring sent on subscribe: it replaces the panel's buffer. Live frames are prepended.

time.description: Trade time, milliseconds since the epoch.

side.description: The taker's side (Hyperliquid B = buy, A = sell).

key.description: time|tid|side|price|size. Unique per trade; the venue's hash is not.

own.description: Present when our master account is the buyer or the seller.

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.
